text: samugghātaṃ gacchantīti .pe. pañcamaṃ . #1 ma. yu. bhikkhu . [61] .pe. anusayā pahīyantīti .pe. chaṭṭhaṃ . [62] .pe. anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti . cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhave anattato jānato passato anusayā samugghātaṃ gacchanti .pe. sotaṃ ghānaṃ jivhaṃ kāyaṃ manaṃ dhamme manoviññāṇaṃ manosamphassaṃ yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato
